_comment: install.sh merges the two entries below into the hooks block of ~/.claude/settings.json, keeping anything already there, with __REPO__ replaced by this repo's absolute path and __VENV_PY__ by the venv interpreter (bin/python on macOS, Scripts/python.exe on Windows); install.sh --uninstall removes them. Both commands fail open: they check the script exists first and exit 0 on any failure, because Claude Code treats exit 2 from UserPromptSubmit (Python's exit code for a missing script) as a block on every prompt. The recall command shows 'rekall unavailable' and logs to ~/.config/rekall/logs/hook.log when it can't run.

hooks.command: S="__REPO__/graph-memory/recall_hook.py"; [ -f "$S" ] && "__VENV_PY__" "$S" || { mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/rekall/logs"; echo "$(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") hook command: $S or __VENV_PY__ missing or failed" >> "$HOME/.config/rekall/logs/hook.log"; echo '{"systemMessage":"rekall unavailable: recall_hook.py or its venv is missing, see ~/.config/rekall/logs/hook.log"}'; }
